## software built around your reality.

Manage, automate, and grow with connected flexibility built for legal complexity.

[See the platform](https://neostella.com/platform/)

Time & Finance

### scale without limits.

As your firm grows, your case management software shouldn’t slow down.

- Enterprise strength with the clarity your team needs.
- Unlimited scale for 1M+ cases and contacts.
- Lightning-fast performance for 100M+ documents.
- Engineered for speed, stability, and no drama.

[See enterprise case management](https://neostella.com/platform/case-management/)

![](https://neostella.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Screen-Visuals-V1-37-scaled.png)

### search without friction.

Fast results across millions of records and documents.

- Search cases, documents, and people at lightning speed.
- AI-powered natural language search.
- Only see results that your permissions allow for.
- Indexing built for large volume.

[Explore the platform](https://neostella.com/platform)

![](https://neostella.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Screen-Visuals-V1-34-scaled.png)

### protect what matters.

Ensure the right people see the right information and nothing else.

- Granular permissions, down to field level control.
- Role-based access that mirrors your actual firm structure.
- Build permission sets once and apply across entire teams.
- Meet operational, ethical, and compliance requirements.

[Explore the platform](https://neostella.com/platform/)

![](https://neostella.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Screen-Visuals-V1-29-scaled.png)

### answer your questions.

Real-time insights across millions of data points.

- Easy-to-build reporting across millions of records.
- Real-time dashboards for quick answers and visibility.
- Permission-aware sharing for sensitive information.

[Capture every minute](https://neostella.com/platform/time-and-billing/)

![](https://neostella.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Screen-Visuals-V1-36-scaled.png)

### automate the routine.

Streamline your workflows and keep cases progressing.

- Built-in no-code automation builder, no run-time fees.
- Automate tasks, routing, time capture, document creation, and more.
- The most advanced legal task management.
- A full sandbox to test changes before they go live.

[Explore platform](https://neostella.com/platform)

![](https://neostella.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Screen-Visuals-V1-24-scaled.png)

### organize documents effortlessly.

Simple, powerful document management.

- Attach one document to multiple cases.
- Organize using advanced tags and folders.
- Draft, edit, and generate documents directly in SharePoint.
- Instantly search full text across all files.

[Automate your documents](https://neostella.com/platform/document-generation/)

![](https://neostella.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Screen-Visuals-V1-29-scaled.png)

### communicate clearly.

Your team needs a place where communication lives with the work.

- Keep emails, SMS, notes, and calendar updates tied directly to cases.
- Ask AI questions and get summaries about the case.
- Use tags to bring the right people into the right conversations.
- Control sensitive communications with advanced permissions.

[Explore the platform](https://neostella.com/platform)

![](https://neostella.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Screen-Visuals-V1-32-scaled.png)

### connect everything.

Create a connected ecosystem of your best-in-class tools.

- 100% open API to integrate systems, even competitors.
- Most advanced webhook and real-time data sync.
- Connect BI, accounting, email, e-signature tools, and more.

[Connect with integrations](https://neostella.com/platform/integrations)

![](https://neostella.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Screen-Visuals-V1-35-scaled.png)

### turn work into revenue.

Your time, expenses, and billing stay connected, so your team captures more, bills faster, and never breaks their flow.

- Track time anywhere you work with automatic capture.
- Turn completed tasks into billable entries instantly.
- Sync time, invoices, and expenses with your accounting system.
- Create accurate invoices in seconds, not days.
- Accelerate cash flow without adding billing staff.

[Connect with integrations](https://neostella.com/platform/integrations)

![](https://neostella.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Screen-Visuals-V1-21.png)
